svg.title: Agent evidence provenance graph
svg.desc: Nodes follow export order. Solid edges are observed evidence, dashed orange edges are uncertain hypotheses, dotted gray edges mean chronology only. No edge proves cognitive influence.
svg.text: Evidence DAG: observed (solid), possible (orange dashed), time only (gray dotted)
Types: task · model · tool call/result · file version · integrity change · policy finding. Labels include type and evidence ID.
